endings.name: The One Who Stayed
endings.summary: He sat on the elders' bench at the Recognition. The shaft sealed and cut his brothers' voices at once; he kept his blue a while longer, felt each of them go as a skipped beat in the wall, and dims the lamps for the next group.

endings.name: Taken by the River
endings.summary: An immune beast took him before the heart. He is turned aside into his own vessel, still holding his gift. The ending is his alone: the rest of the raft reach the heart with an empty place and are separated as written.

endings.name: Two Together
endings.summary: Two brothers who rowed in time all river long squeezed on the song's last note and were swept into one chamber. Everyone else is lost to them.

endings.name: Carried Away
endings.summary: The current splits in the heart and every brother is swept a different way, holding the tool another carved for him. "No one stays together."
